title: Phones Are Getting Smarter! Google Is Testing Gemini-Powered Accessibility Features for Pixel 11

content_html:
Google is currently actively developing a new experimental feature for the upcoming Pixel 11 series, called "Device Help" powered by Gemini. This feature aims to help users easily solve various issues encountered during phone usage in a more intuitive and intelligent way.

In terms of specific function access and experience, this experimental feature is designed at the bottom of the "plus" menu in the Gemini app. However, the feature is currently in the testing phase and is only available for a select group of users.

As a core highlight, "Device Help" can deeply answer users' questions about phone usage through smooth natural language conversations. It can provide detailed and intuitive assistance for daily troubleshooting, precise system settings adjustments, optimization of storage space and notification management, as well as图文 guidance for complex system functions.

Although this innovative feature is highly anticipated, its underlying stability and overall functionality are still under continuous optimization. Google has not yet officially announced the exact release date for this feature.
